campaign_basis: Prove governed-work semantics using one externally supplied horizon and one externally supplied live gap before introducing generalized horizon representation or machine selection.

gap_stratification.evidentiary: Has the claimed relation earned standing?
gap_stratification.operative_relational: What currently consequential relation is unresolved?
gap_stratification.architectural_capability: What machinery is missing for later classes of relational gaps?

current_gap.statement: RELATIONAL_HORIZON_V0 has matched standing, but the system does not yet have standing to mechanically return the exact sole declared work-eligible gap or NO_JUSTIFIED_WORK from one validated horizon state.

CONTROL_KERNEL_CELL_001.effective_claim: One externally supplied operative horizon with exactly one externally supplied live gap and no competing gaps reconciles against one bounded observed repository repair to HORIZON_SATISFIED, empty supplied gap set, NO_JUSTIFIED_WORK, and STOP.

CONTROL_KERNEL_CELL_002.effective_claim: One externally supplied relational horizon preserves stable logical horizon identity while state identity changes from PARTIAL with one declared live gap to CLOSED with an empty declared gap set.
